case.summary: This alert was triggered by an autonomous monitor flagging transaction 3579943 because its device profile was shared as a new device by five customers on card C07212-K2. Graph evidence showed the device profile had already been used five times on this card, the $249.94 amount was typical for the customer, and the transaction model scored the event at a very low 0.002. Furthermore, the card had a prior false alarm, and the customer confirmed making this purchase. The verdict is legitimate with no fraud pattern identified. The final actions are to ALLOW_TRANSACTION and CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.
